name: tangleai
description: Tangle AI — self-improving memory and retrieval for agents, built on the @jarenjs suite
author: Joham <jklarenbeek@gmail.com>

scripts.desktop:ui: bun build apps/desktop/src/ui/main.ts --outfile apps/desktop/public/app.js --format esm --target browser && cat node_modules/@jarenjs/charts/styles/charts.css node_modules/@jarenjs/mermaid/styles/mermaid.css node_modules/@jarenjs/md/styles/md.css > apps/desktop/public/vendor.css
scripts.desktop:compile: npm run desktop:ui && bun scripts/embed-assets.ts && bun build --compile apps/desktop/src/main.ts --outfile dist/tangle; git checkout -- apps/desktop/src/assets.gen.ts
